name: Wishbone - 46 Handoff

QB.rule: Open right, hand to the right halfback, then fake the boot. It holds the backside end.

RH.rule: Take the handoff downhill at our tackle's outside hip, following the fullback. Never bounce it outside.

LH.rule: Run hard to the left like you have the ball. You are what holds the backside.

coaching_points: This is Power without a slot, and it changes nothing on the line: the right tight end takes the end man, same as always. The yards are inside that block.
The fullback leads through the hole. His man is whoever shows, not a man he picks before the snap — including the outside linebacker if that is who fills.
The right halfback's most common mistake is bouncing it wide. Make him run it tight until it is automatic.
